selection_basis: The 2026 WGCSE report presents the applied Irish Sea SAM. Catch-at-age, two tuning indices, stock and catch weights, M, N and F at age, and aggregate outputs are recoverable from official tables. Revised maturity and native fit files remain unverified.

selection_basis: The 2026 WHAM Management Track is used for advice. Its public support archive contains the fixed and mobile catch age proportions and describes the fitted run. The parameter supplement tabulates annual N and fleet-specific and total F at age.
